core_principles: Modern and minimal with an organic, natural touch.
Card-based UI for plants and care schedules with soft shadows.
High whitespace to create a breathing room, emphasizing the plants.
Clear, actionable reminders and a scanner-first utility approach.
design_philosophy.vibe: Calm, grounded, functional, and deeply connected to nature.

rules: Headings should use font-medium or font-bold with tight tracking.
Never use Inter or generic default fonts for headings.
Body text should be readable and generously spaced.

alignment: Center align hero and empty states.
Left align plant details, forms, and cards.
Mobile-first layouts with single column, expanding to multi-column bento grids on desktop.

glassmorphism.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-border/40 sticky top-0 z-50
glassmorphism.scanner_controls: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/20 shadow-lg text-white

buttons.primary: bg-brand-primary text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-brand-primary_hover transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-text-primary rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-border transition-colors border border-border/50
buttons.scanner: w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-4 border-white/80 bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white/40 transition-all

inputs.search: bg-secondary border-none rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-text-primary placeholder:text-text-muted focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-primary/30
inputs.select: bg-white border border-border rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-primary/30

badges.pet_friendly: bg-[#E6F4EA] text-[#2D6A4F] text-xs font-medium px-3 py-1 rounded-full
badges.light_need: bg-[#FFF8E7] text-[#B58500] text-xs font-medium px-3 py-1 rounded-full
badges.water_due: bg-[#E8F1F2] text-[#1B6CA8] text-xs font-medium px-3 py-1 rounded-full

shadcn_overrides: Remove hard borders on standard tabs, use pill-shaped interactive states.
Cards should have maximum corner radius (rounded-2xl) and subtle ambient shadow.

rules: Hover states for all interactive elements.
Staggered entrance for My Plants list.

hero_background.description: Minimalist 3D rendering of indoor plant in terracotta pot. Use for hero or landing background.

scanner_lifestyle.description: Person scanning a lush plant with their phone. Use for onboarding or feature highlight.

plant_collection.description: Collection of modern indoor plants. Use for empty states, 'My Plants' header, or category headers.

ui_photo_1.description: Row of potted plants on shelves. Use for recommendations section.

ui_photo_2.description: Green-leafed plant in modern setting. Use for specific plant profile mockups.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Use kebab-case and role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a modern, minimalistic React app utilizing Tailwind CSS. Do not use generic fonts for headings; stick to Cabinet Grotesk or a similar strong sans.
features: Implement a prominent 'Scan Plant' FAB or hero button.
Create a 'My Plants' dashboard utilizing the card styling with soft shadows and staggered entrance animations.
The plant profile must include details like watering schedule, light needs, and a pet-friendly badge.
Add a 'Recommendations' section with filters for lighting and pets.
instructions_to_main_agent.limitations: Ensure high contrast for text. Never use pure #000000 for text, use the primary text color (#1A2E20).
